description:
Goal

A demanded callable TransportShape(position) refines exact carried producer relations into one physical representation. ABI, backend, interpreter, and native consumers use that answer; none reselect producer identity from types, joined demand surfaces, ShapeIds, ordering, or session inventories.

North-star contract

- There is no transport seal, completion pass, or whole-world census.
- One requested product produces from exact current fact/product reads or returns exact waits.
- Completion is revision-relative to the exact publisher frontier already requested by the product DAG. If three publishers are requested, the third current production completes that frontier. A later request creates a new frontier revision.
- Dependency revisions/generations are memo metadata, never part of ProductValue.
- Product generations advance only when immutable values change.
- Only actual product back-edges may settle as one cyclic group. A recursive dependency cone is not automatically an SCC.

Proven requested boundary

Spike bf021f6fecba4f0db57989dbb4aafa92de3a2ae3 traced the paired Enum.drop_while multi-producer slot reduce_while_cont input 2.

The current full solve projected 25 executables, 207 equality components, and 408 positions. The requested component itself had 1 position, 1 anchor, and 0 equalities. It is not an SCC.

The slot had two carried sources. Each independently projected Exact to a distinct callable ShapeId. callable_input_shapes_for_demand accepted zero, so aggregate projection became Unknown and installed a generic fallback. Reversing publisher order was identical. Physical selection is deleting already-valid producer relations and reconstructing eligibility from joined rendering.

Current recursive projection touched 18 executable contexts. That is a measured dependency cone, not proof that all members are necessary or cyclic.

Proven current product-model break

- ProductDriver receives exact parent waits, but ProductMemo discards the parent-child edge when the parent unblocks.
- ProductMemo has no product generations or dependency metadata.
- Already-produced child reads through session.memo and direct World fact reads never appear in waits.
- OutgoingInputEdges(E) returns Unit after append-only session mutation, is not invalidated with its source authorities, and cannot replace or withdraw a contribution.
- IncomingInputSlot can settle empty while a known requested outgoing publisher is waiting.
- CallableFacts and BoundaryFacts snapshot optional pass-side inventories.
- solve_transport_closure overproduces unrelated components and side-publishes inventories that later manufacture root demand.

Proven frontier authority

Spike 890396ae84a804f14600674b7c409beb5a367206 compared three ownership models.

Chosen model:

- ProductDriver owns one exact request-local index of requested OutgoingInputEdges keys.
- OutgoingEdgeFrontier(root) is a tiny immutable order-free product set view of that index, not a second authority.
- OutgoingInputEdges(E) owns its immutable full edge contribution.
- IncomingInputSlot(slot) derives sources from the frontier and every named outgoing child.
- Generic memo metadata records product/fact reads and generations, including cache hits and missing waits.

A PullSession request index alone was rejected because cached consumers would still need custom validity compensation. A parent-carried narrower reverse publisher list was rejected because no current upstream value carries it; constructing one requires a scan or reconstruction. All requested outgoing publishers is the smallest honest currently-carried domain.

The lifecycle proof covers first/duplicate/unrelated requests, durable pending membership, last-publisher completion, later frontier revision, equal reproduction, no-edge new publishers, withdrawal, and forward/reverse order. A no-edge publisher refreshes dependency metadata but preserves the slot value and generation. Only changed sources advance the slot generation.

Required physical refinement

Transport consumes every complete carried producer/use relation.

- Zero relations is incomplete or absent according to the exact upstream domain; it is not permission to invent a semantic fallback.
- One relation may use a direct representation only when carried authority says direct-only. Otherwise it uses the public carrier.
- Multiple producer identities retain all alternatives and use their common public boxed callable ABI. Physical equality never chooses identity.

Atomic foundation\n\nThe original fz-k22.5.1-.4 decomposition was falsified by measured exact-invalidation behavior. Append-only incoming-edge pushes cleared five live closure epochs; the revisioned intermediate performed 19 successful whole-closure solves versus the baseline 3. No debounce, seal, or stale-cache suppression is valid. Those scopes are now one atomic fz-k22.5.1 change: generic revisioned products, driver-owned requested outgoing frontier, immutable replacement outgoing contributions, and incoming slots derived from that frontier. fz-k22.5.1 directly blocks this ticket.\n\nNext proof gate after fz-k22.5.1

Prove the narrow position-product recursion and local raw-source boundary:

TransportShape(Input)
  -> current IncomingInputSlot
  -> exact TransportShape(Value(producer, value)) children
  -> common physical ABI over every carried relation

A candidate TransportSourceFacts(E) may carry local positions, equalities, anchor recipes, input-slot references, callable producer descriptors, and already-selected semantic mappings. It must not project ShapeIds or read neighboring contexts. Historical ExecutableTransportFacts performed context-sensitive projection and is not reusable.

Only actual reentry in the position-product DAG may group settlement. Callable construction remains a separate producer-position product. CallableFacts and BoundaryFacts must derive from named construction products or wait.

Signal

- The paired input pulls both producer-value children and no unrelated component.
- Both valid producers survive into one public callable ABI; same-layout distinct identities cannot cross-select.
- Exact requests, reads, waits, generations, withdrawals, and child products are observable.
- Whole-closure projection, snapshot facades, physical selector/fallback, manufactured demand, custom freshness ledgers, and obsolete cache tests are removed rather than compensated.
- Lower layers consume the final transport answer without reconstruction.

Scope

No transport implementation begins before fz-k22.5.1-.4 close and the raw-source/position boundary is proven. fz-k22.30 remains blocked here. fz-k22.31 owns the uncalled first-class discrepancy. fz-k22.29 may consume the eventual authority only after it exists.
title: Make callable transport determination a product-owned refinement
